title: Expected squared separation under shared sphere noise
source_anchor: Complete source-only.json: D1-D6, A1-A5, F1-F3, P1-P6 and B1-B5
target_statement: Let \(E=\mathbb R^d\), \(S=\{x\in E:\|x\|=1\}\), and \(C=S^N\), with \(N>0\). On one probability space with a complete right-continuous filtration, let each \(B_i\) be a standard \(E\)-valued Brownian motion relative to that filtration. Let \(X_i,Y_i\) be supplied jointly measurable, strongly progressive processes taking values in \(S\). Fix \(\lambda\ge0\) and continuous fields \(b_X,b_Y:[0,\infty)\times C\times C\to E^N\). Assume the coordinate integral forms of the displayed SDEs hold on every positive finite horizon, almost surely simultaneously at every time on that horizon. The two equations for particle \(i\) use the same \(B_i\). Then the expected normalized squared chord separation has the exact integral and derivative identities below. With the negative-time clamping convention, \(G\) is also continuous and locally integrable on all of \(\mathbb R\); these are conclusions of the theorem.
